events.title: Follow Ireland's new rule?
events.body: Irish media report tighter rules: new data centres must supply more of their own renewable energy and ease the strain on the grid. Adopt the same rule for Bournemouth?
options: Adopt: new centres include a renewable deal (+25% cost)
events.reveal:
[data]SOURCE[/data]  Supplied media review of RTÉ and Irish Times coverage.

[assumption]ASSUMPTION[/assumption]  Rejecting the rule costs 4 acceptance points in the local press; adopting it adds a renewable deal to every new centre.
